answer: Test the quote, not the claim. Each answer carries a TEE quote with a hardware id, so ten clones on one box show one id and earn one seat. A second panel re-queues 10% of passes, and any answer that fails there loses the bond. Example: a jetty of 500 keys on 50 boxes gives 50 hardware ids, so the farm lands 50 seats from 500 keys and pays 500 bonds for the privilege. The kernel of the check is the id, and the nectar follows the id.
